partnership_announcements.description: Modern Treasury and Palus Finance entered a partnership in which Palus uses Modern Treasury’s Payments API and compliance tools to power multi-rail fiat payments and ledgering for its treasury management platform.

press_references.value: Modern Treasury Partners with Persona to Enhance Business Onboarding and Compliance

press_references.value: Anchorage Digital Selects Modern Treasury to Power Money Movement Infrastructure

partnership_announcements.description: Modern Treasury announced a partnership under which Anchorage Digital will use Modern Treasury’s payments and ledger infrastructure to automate money movement across wires, ACH, and real-time rails, enabling faster interbank payments, automated settlements, and real-time liquidity visibility.

press_references.value: Modern Treasury Taps Blankfactor to Scale Enterprise Implementation Services

partnership_announcements.description: Modern Treasury has announced a formalized partnership with Blankfactor to scale its enterprise implementation services. This collaboration will enhance Modern Treasury's professional services for enterprise customers, leveraging Blankfactor's technical expertise in payment systems integration and infrastructure.

press_references.value: Modern Treasury and Brico Partner to Transform Payment Operations Through Automated Licensing

partnership_announcements.description: Modern Treasury and Brico have announced a strategic partnership to transform payment operations through automated licensing. This alliance aims to accelerate the adoption of embedded payments by providing joint customers with seamless licensing compliance and integrated money movement solutions.

overview_description.description:
Modern Treasury enables its clients to marry bank statements with the company’s business logic to provide an enriched history of the company’s financial transactions. This view will empower the company’s finance teams to focus on solving the mission-critical problems of the business and not piecing together the jigsaw puzzle of bank transactions by hand. Modern Treasury will help answer those questions faster and with more confidence.

The company's tools automate the full cycle of money movement—from payment initiation, through approvals, to reconciliation—and are accessible through a web application or API.
